title: Ten-item comparison family-balance audit
diagnosis: Uniform sampling over materialized readings overrepresents the recursive kinship grammar because one grammar expands to many readings.
The comparison surface is intended to show variety, so candidate-count proportional sampling is not the best product objective.
The issue is separate from dnaOne() v0.84 because the comparison button builds a new combined pool.

proposed_l1_strata.definition: public seed pool, excluding readings already selected

fallback: If a stratum cannot fill its quota, fill remaining slots from the combined unused pool.
invariants: Exactly 10 unique readings when at least 10 candidates exist.
L2/L3 comparison behavior remains unchanged initially.
The comparison list continues to show origin, japanese_quality, and weirdness.

expected_effect.recursive_items: about 4.4 average -> exactly 2 under normal L1 conditions
expected_effect.mechanism_diversity: At least seed, nonrecursive DNA, recursive DNA, and seam mechanisms appear in each normal L1 comparison.
